A 2023 arXiv research paper by Shi-Qiang Chen. For any given set
A
of nonnegative integers and for any given two positive integers
k_{1},k_{2}
,
R_{k_{1},k_{2}}(A,n)

is defined as the number of solutions of the equation
n=k_{1}a_{1}+k_{2}a_{2}
with
a_{1},a_{2}\in A
. In this paper, we prove that if integer
k\geq 2
and set
A\subseteq\mathbb{N}
such that
R_{1,k}(A,n)=R_{1,k}(\mathbb{N}\setminus A,n)
holds for all integers
n\geq n_{0}
, then
R_{1,k}(A,n)\gg\log n
. 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification:
11B13

Partition; weighted representation function

pmc-12409930.title: Iatrogenic cerebral amyloid angiopathy: two new cases and systematic review of case reports with neuropathological data
pmc-12409930.creator: Ana Sofia Costa, João Pinho, Arno Reich, Omid Nikoubashman, Kay Nolte, Joachim Weis, Christian Boy, Felix M. Mottaghy, Jörg B. Schulz, Kathrin Reetz
pmc-12409930.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Awareness concerning iatrogenic cerebral amyloid angiopathy (iCAA) is increasing but its pathophysiology remains unclear. We discuss the implications of the clinical, imaging and neuropathological findings in two previously unpublished cases of probable iCAA: a 55-year-old female presenting with rapidly progressive cognitive impairment, showing imaging and histological evidence of CAA and having undergone neurosurgical treatment at the age of 6; and a 56-year-old male with a four-year history of recurring intracerebral hemorrhages (ICH) and neurosurgical intervention at the age of 5.

pmc-13079639.title: Postnatal Bisphenol A exposure and risk of precocious puberty in children: updated systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-13079639.creator: Bassam Bin-Abbas, Mosleh Ali Jabari
pmc-13079639.description: BackgroundPrecocious puberty (PP), defined as the development of secondary sexual characteristics before age eight in girls or nine in boys, has shown a rising prevalence globally. Bisphenol A (BPA), an endocrine-disrupting chemical commonly found in plastics, has been suggested to influence pubertal timing, but epidemiological evidence remains inconsistent.

pmc-13092759.title: HPRT-YOLO: Enhanced lightweight UAV maritime search and rescue model based on YOLOv11n
pmc-13092759.creator: Zhengyang Gao, Yuantai Li, Yipeng Shao, Fazhan Tao, Zhikai Wang, Guanyang Chen
pmc-13092759.description: SummarySmall target detection is crucial for unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) maritime search and rescue (SAR), but problems, including low target spatial resolution, dynamic marine environments, and severe background interference, often cause frequent missed/false detections and insufficient real-time performance. To address these issues, we propose HPRT-YOLO, a lightweight model based on YOLOv11n.

pmc-13099912.title: Identification of risk factors for heavy clinical burden in electrical workers of highlands: a cross-sectional study
pmc-13099912.creator: Qingqing Su, Qinghua He, Yonglin Fu, Qiang Lin, Haiying Xian, Tingting Liu, Miao Li, Hao Wang, Wenjin Sun, Xuan Zhang, Ling Chen, Hui Yan, Lei Chen, Fengming Luo
pmc-13099912.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundAcute and chronic mountain sickness, resulting from maladaptation to high-altitude hypoxia, poses a great health concern. This study aimed to identify risk factors for heavy symptom-based clinical burden among high-altitude electrical workers.MethodsIn this cross-sectional study, 444 electrical workers stationed in the highlands of Sichuan, China, completed a symptom questionnaire and were classified as heavy (≥3 symptoms) or light (<3) clinical burden. Univariable and multivariable logistic regression identified factors associated with heavy clinical burden.

pmc-13249191.title: Sorting Science From Marketing in the Era of Data-Driven Biological Aging Clocks
pmc-13249191.creator: Jenna Congdon
pmc-13249191.description: Consumer wearables provide users with a wealth of data, including an estimation of their “biological age.” In this News and Perspectives article, JMIR Correspondent Jenna Congdon reports on the accuracy and utility of age prediction by wearables. Key Takeaways: Wearable “biological age” scores are based on proxy data, like sleep, heart rate, and activity.

pmc-13396743.title: Microbiome-Modulating Effects of Heat-Treated Lactiplantibacillus plantarum LM1004 and Its Enhancement of NK Cell Activity: Evidence from a Clinical Trial and a Simulated Human Intestinal Microbiome Ecosystem
pmc-13396743.creator: Sukyung Kim, Hoonhee Seo, Tae-Rahk Kim, Md Abdur Rahim, Hanieh Tajdozian, Youjin Yoon, Sujin Jo, Md Sarower Hossen Shuvo, Indrajeet Barman, Chaeeun Park, Saebim Lee, Sangwon Lee, Min Hyung Cho, Jangho Ha, Hansol Hong, Sohee An, SungJune Chu, Minn Sohn, Yoo Kyung Ahn, Yoon Ju So, Sungsue Rheem, Seong
pmc-13396743.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Probiotics are increasingly recognized for their capacity to modulate gut microbiota, regulate microbial metabolic activity, and influence host immune responses, thereby contributing to the maintenance of immune homeostasis and overall health. In this study, we assessed the efficacy and safety of heat-treated Lactiplantibacillus plantarum LM1004 (HT-LM1004) in a randomized, placebo-controlled clinical trial and explored its mechanisms of action in a simulated human intestinal microbiome ecosystem.

pmc-13415358.title: Oxidized regenerated cellulose particles enable high-pressure air-leak sealing on lung segmentectomy surfaces in porcine models
pmc-13415358.creator: Qianrui Ren, Kun Wang, Wenbo Sun, Zhibo Wang, Xinfeng Xu, Wei Wen, Quan Zhu
pmc-13415358.description: ObjectivePulmonary air leakage is a common complication that hinders rapid recovery after lung segmentectomy. Oxidized regenerated cellulose flat (ORCF) combined with fibrin glue (FG) has shown efficacy in preventing air leaks in previous studies but is limited by inadequate tissue coverage.

pmc-13474809.title: Complete mitochondrial and phylogenetic relationships of Dermacentor everestianus (Acari: Ixodidae) and Alveonasus sp. (Acari: Argasidae)
pmc-13474809.creator: Xialing Zhao, Bin Shi, Wenqiang Tang, Zengqiang Liu, Chenyang Xia
pmc-13474809.description: BackgroundTicks are hematophagous arthropods capable of transmitting pathogens threatening human and animal health. The use of individual gene markers has limited phylogenetic studies of ticks, but the mitochondrial genome offers critical data for understanding phylogeny and molecular evolution.ResultsThe mitogenomes of Dermacentor everestianus and Alveonasus sp. were assembled from Illumina 350 bp pair-end reads.

pmc-13661856.title: Leopard sterilisation in India: The ecological and ethical costs of anthropocentric wildlife management
pmc-13661856.creator: Pranay Arora
pmc-13661856.description: India’s rising human–leopard conflict has prompted the government to adopt immune contraceptives to manage leopard populations. The decision has sparked debate among wildlife experts and conservation organisations, government officials, and local communities. Here, I discuss the ecological and ethical implications of this intervention and highlight alternative, coexistence-based approaches that recognise both humans and wildlife as stakeholders within shared socio-ecological systems.
